in_text_mentions: Radiographic examination showed reduced thickness and radiodensity of the enamel and dentin in the upper right primary teeth, consistent with the “ghost tooth” pattern. In contrast, the upper left and lower primary teeth showed root and crown development compatible with the patient's age, with no structural alterations, confirming the regional pattern of odontodysplasia (Figure 2).
